title: Mahou Isekai
description: You reincarnated in the world of Minecraft, and now you wield the power of an Archmage! A massive spellcasting overhaul addon for Mahou Tsukai.
body:
# Mahou Isekai

**> ⚠️ **ALPHA VERSION NOTICE**
> Please be aware that this mod is currently in its early **Alpha** stage:
> * **Visual Overhaul:** All current particle layouts and visual effects are temporary placeholders. They will be completely overhauled with high-quality custom renders and animations in future updates.
> * **Alpha Spell Pool:** The current list of available spells is just a basic selection for technical testing. A massive expansion is already planned.
> * **Interface Upgrades:** The current spell selection mechanic is basic. A significantly more comfortable, customizable, and intuitive HUD and Grimoire management system is currently under active development.**

Mahou Isekai is a [Mahou Tsukai](https://modrinth.com/mod/mahou-tsukai) addon inspired by Isekai anime that completely overhaul the standard scroll mechanics in favor of an RPG-style magic progression system. Instead of cluttering your inventory with physical scroll items, all unlocked magic is managed through a dedicated client HUD and materialized directly into your hands when needed.

---

## Features

### Awakening System & Progression
* **The Awakening Ritual:** To unlock your magical potential, take any source of damage in Survival mode, look directly down at the ground, and press **M**. This initiates a 5-second cinematic ritual featuring a soul-fire vortex, acoustic heartbeats, and a terminal lightning strike.
* **Talent Roulette:** Your potential is evaluated upon awakening. The system spreads across 9 distinct strength tiers, permanently assigning you a custom class based on your rolled potential.
* **XP-Linked Mana & Progression:** Spells are strictly locked behind player XP level requirements (ranging from basic utility up to ultimate reality-altering magic). Your maximum mana scales directly with your current XP level. 
* **Restoration:** Passive mana regeneration is disabled. Instead, your mana pool fully refills every morning at sunrise or upon sleeping in a bed.

### Graphical User Interface (HUD)
* **Dynamic Magic Overlay:** A customizable HUD element in the bottom-left corner tracks your active spell, draws accurate item-stack renders dynamically from registry IDs, and shifts its border colors depending on your magic tier.
* **Spell Selection:** Use the **Z** key to cycle through available magic. 
* **Real-time Cooldowns:** Visual ticking cooldown clocks are displayed directly over the HUD, combined with player level restriction locks.

### Casting & Combat
* **Direct Casting:** Pressing or holding **R** instantly materializes the selected scroll or weapon into your off-hand. For staffs or shields, hold **R** and use Right-Click.
* **Dimensional Escape:** Pressing **R** while inside your own Reality Marble tears space open, teleporting you safely back to your Overworld coordinate baseline.

---

## How to Start

1. **Awaken Magic:** Take damage, look down at the ground, and press **M** to begin the ritual.
2. **Select Spell:** Use the **Z** key to switch between your unlocked abilities.
3. **Cast:** Press **R** for regular scrolls. Hold **R** and Right-Click for staffs or shields.
4. **Refill Mana:** Sleep in a bed or wait until sunrise for a full mana restoration.

---

## Technical Specifications & Requirements

* **Minecraft Version:** 1.20.1
* **Mod Loader:** Forge
* **Dependencies:** [Mahou Tsukai](https://modrinth.com/mod/mahou-tsukai) (Required)
* **Localization:** Full out-of-the-box support for English (`en_us`) and Russian (`ru_ru`).
